description: A charming traditional residential front entryway with a warm country character. The exterior facade is constructed in stacked cream-toned brick with a rough, slightly irregular texture, giving the porch a cottage-like quality. The front door is a solid dark walnut-stained wood with raised panel detailing and nine divided-light windows across the upper third, fitted with an oil-rubbed bronze lever handle and deadbolt. A woven wicker hanging basket filled with white blooms adorns the door at mid-height. The covered porch landing features a printed coir doormat with a leaf motif and a woven black border. To the left of the door, a trio of potted plants at the base of the entry step includes a terracotta pot with small yellow flowers, a galvanized metal bucket with a compact boxwood, and a round woven wicker basket. The porch overhang creates a protected entry zone. A warm amber glow washes across the brick face beside the door from a nearby source, casting soft illumination down the brick surface and picking out the texture of each course. Camera at standing eye-level, off-center thirds composition with the door filling the right two-thirds and the brick porch wall to the left, lens at normal character, level pitch.
